note.zh-TW: 網站補充的延伸科目，課程模板沒有這一列；不列入期中考範圍。
note.en: An extension account added by the site; the course template has no such line and it is outside the midterm scope.

definition.zh-TW:
公司已經決議要發放、但還沒實際付給股東的現金股利。

從決議那天到付款那天之間，這筆錢是公司欠股東的負債。
definition.en:
Cash dividends the company has resolved to pay but has not yet handed to shareholders.

Between the resolution date and the payment date the amount is a liability owed to the owners.

example.zh-TW: 位置：資產負債表流動負債；這是網站補充的延伸科目，課程模板沒有這一列，也不列入期中考範圍。決議時未分配盈餘減少、應付股利增加；付款時現金與應付股利一起減少，現金流量表列籌資活動的支付股息。
example.en: Where it sits: current liabilities on the balance sheet; it is an extension account added by the site, absent from the course template and outside the midterm scope. On resolution, unappropriated retained earnings fall and dividends payable rise; on payment, cash and the payable fall together and the outflow appears as dividends paid under financing activities.

misconception.zh-TW: 以為決議發股利的那一天現金就少了。現金是在實際付款那天才流出；決議當天只是產生一筆負債，資產總計還沒變。
misconception.en: Assuming cash drops on the day the dividend is declared. Cash only leaves when the dividend is actually paid; the declaration creates a liability and total assets are unchanged at that point.
